exercises_coverage: 59/94 leaf topics have exercises (62 total); definitional/reference leaves skipped per rubric
level_distribution: 3 Level-1, 3 Level-2, 3 Level-3 depth-0 topics (33/33/33 vs 30/40/30 target)
images: 121 images described and applied; 106 attached to chunks (15 belong to deliberately excluded sections)
quality_concerns: structure.orphan_section (131): all deliberate exclusions, audited individually — Azure product walkthroughs (Azure Managed Redis recipes, Azure Monitor autoscale, APIM, compute-platform comparisons, background-job hosting menus), system-design-primer interview-prep meta (study guide, question banks, Anki, company blogs, license), big-data/big-compute and embedded-architecture pages (outside the web-focused scope), and docfx description stubs (4-8 words). Two genuine misses found during the audit (microservices design-patterns catalog, 'Collect usage data') were added to the structure before approval.

chunks.token_range (40): 30 extensive + 10 variant chunks outside the soft range; all within hard bounds. Mostly topic tail chunks (202-484 tokens) produced by the chunker's fill-then-remainder behaviour, plus a few 1500-1700 token chunks where a single section exceeded the target. Content quality unaffected; chunker improvement suggested in PIPELINE_FEEDBACK.md #7.

extracted.duplicate_title (10): cross-source duplicates ('Security', 'Entities', 'SQL or NoSQL', 'Introduction', 'Microservices', 'Deployment', 'Other considerations', 'Introduction: Challenges'); every structure reference to these uses the new file-qualified 'file.json::Title' form, so chunking resolved them unambiguously (chunk_report: 0 unmatched).

structure.giant_topic (1): 'SLA, Usage, and Audit Monitoring' maps 11 source sections — kept together because the SLA/audit/usage trio is one coherent monitoring block of short sections (~1950 tokens total).

Known content nits: chunk text retains relative markdown links from source repos (e.g. '[actor](part-3-design-principles.md#...)') which will be dead links in the app; the markdown extractor could strip or de-link these (PIPELINE_FEEDBACK.md). Some Clean Architecture summary subsections are inherently terse (the source is a summary); objectives for those leaves were scoped to what the text supports.

judgment_checks.objective_answerability: Sampled leaves across all 9 depth-0 topics (including the smallest: 'Functional Programming and Immutability', 'Case Study: Video Sales') — objectives answerable from attached chunks; objectives were authored directly from the section map.
judgment_checks.exercise_solvability: Spot-checked exercises from each batch (SDP instability computation, ETag optimistic-concurrency flow, composite availability math) — solutions correct and grounded in chunk content; all 62 exercises have exactly 3 progressive hints and 2-4 realistic mistakes.
judgment_checks.ordering: Depth-0 ordering follows the exploration concept order (foundations → principles → clean architecture → styles → web → API → scalability → microservices → operations); prerequisite graph is acyclic with no transitive redundancy (validator clean).
judgment_checks.naming: Topic titles are noun phrases without chapter numbers or source branding; cross-source generic titles disambiguated.
